purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/brother-cs7000x.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Brother USA product page, $279.99 list shown, spec tables and In the Box list.
Lists two warranty statements and links to the Online Solution Center for manuals.
Index of manuals for product hf_cs7000xeus. First entry is the operation manual below; others are the Sewing Guide, quick reference guide, accessory sheet and stitch chart.

32 pages, text layer. Product Code 888-N00/N02/N20/N22/N40/N42/N60. The model name CS7000X does not appear in the text; it is the first manual on the CS7000X manuals index, so treat it as a shared-platform manual. No specifications table.
One page, Brother standard limited warranty (XF5055-101, 2017). Linked from the CS7000X product page; generic, not model-specific.

facts.value: 'new higher end automatic needle threader'; spec table 'Needle Threading System Automatic'
'Quick-set bobbin system'; spec table 'Quick Set Bobbin Yes'. Manual: open the bobbin cover, drop the bobbin in.
'adjustable sewing speed control'; manual: slide controller sets bobbin winding speed and the foot controller's maximum speed. Start/stop button disabled when the foot controller is connected.

facts.value: No needle system designation (130/705H, HAx1) found in the operation manual text or on the product page. Manual fabric table names needle sizes 65/9 to 100/16.
facts.note: The spec value is sourced to manualslib, not to a Brother document. Brother's own PDF names sizes only. Verify against the PDF's needle page or the rating plate; household flat-shank is standard for this class but unconfirmed here.

facts.value: No automatic thread trimmer stated on the page or in the manual. The manual shows a manual thread cutter on the machine side.
LCD; stitch selector 'Mode & Shift Key'; adjustable screen brightness No; memory card reader No; lettering fonts 0

Page 'In the Box': '10 sewing feet including: Zigzag foot, Buttonhole foot, Zipper foot, Button sewing foot, Overcasting foot, Blind stitch foot, Monogramming foot, Walking foot and Quilting Foot, Quilt guide'. That names nine feet plus a quilt guide.
facts.spec_value: 10 presser feet; detachable wide table; hard protective case
facts.note: Within the page: the spec table 'Included Accessory Feet' also lists a 1/4" foot (11 items including quilt guide), the In the Box list does not. Page-vs-manual: the manual's optional accessories table sells the walking foot (SA140), quilting foot (SA129), 1/4 in piecing foot (SA125) and quilting guide (SA132) separately, with a note 'Sold separately with some models'; it refers to an 'Included Accessories' sheet that was not fetched. Count of included feet is therefore soft.

site.label: Included feet
site.juki: 10 sewing feet listed (nine feet plus quilt guide); spec table also lists 1/4 in foot

facts.value: 'detachable wide table'; 'hard-protective cover'. The wide table is the flat bed attachment with accessory compartment per the manual (part SAWT7 sold separately).
facts.spec_value: detachable wide table; hard protective case

facts.value: '25 Year Limited Warranty' on the product page. Linked PDF (generic Brother standard limited warranty, not model-specific): 1 year Parts, Labor and accompanying Accessory Items; 2 years Electronic Components and Printed Circuit Boards (replacement labor excluded); 25 Years Chassis Casting. Original purchase date from receipt; products bought from other than an authorized Brother reseller in the US, or used or refurbished, 'may not be covered'. Printed circuit board labor is charged. Shipping and packing are at the owner's cost. Also: 'free customer phone and online technical support for the life of the product'.
facts.spec_value: 25 yr chassis casting, 2 yr electronic components and PCBs (replacement labor excluded), 1 yr parts, labor and accessories
facts.note: Matches the spec. Not model-specific. A second statement (9800 Brother Limited Warranty Standard) is also linked on the support page and was not fetched.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 25 Year Limited Warranty; PDF: 1 yr parts/labor/accessories, 2 yr electronics, 25 yr chassis casting
